# Epigram - llms-full.txt

This is a placeholder llms-full.txt file for Epigram, an open-source, free,
AI-powered news app that delivers concise summaries and in-depth analysis.

## About

Epigram curates news from trusted sources and uses AI to summarize stories for
busy readers. It offers a personalized feed, topic browsing, and optional deep
dives into individual stories.

- Website: https://epigram.news
